name: ToolSandbox
intro: ToolSandbox是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在有状态、对话式和交互式场景中工具使用能力的基准。它包含状态化的工具执行、工具间的隐式状态依赖，以及一个支持策略性对话评估的内置用户模拟器。该基准旨在揭示开源与专有模型在处理状态依赖、规范化及信息不足等复杂任务时的性能差距。
build_method: 双专家场景构建, 里程碑DAG与minefield标注, 至少四轮模型迭代验证
eval_feature: 多轮, 过程导向, State-based
build_method_en: Two-expert scenario construction, milestone DAG and minefield annotation, at least four model-validation rounds
intro_en: ToolSandbox is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' (LLM) ability to use tools in stateful, conversational, and interactive scenarios. It includes stateful tool execution, implicit state dependencies between tools, and a built-in user simulator that supports strategic dialogue evaluation. The benchmark aims to reveal performance gaps between open-source and proprietary models in handling complex tasks involving state dependencies, normalization, and information insufficiency.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ToolSandbox arXiv:2408.04682, Sections 3-4 and Appendix A; official apple/ToolSandbox repository. ToolSandbox defines 34 stateful tools across 11 domains and a built-in user simulator. Two internal experts first create self-contained single-tool seed scenarios, then compose and branch them into multi-tool, multi-turn, state-dependent, canonicalization, and insufficient-information variants. Each scenario specifies an initial database state, user task, available tools, a milestone DAG, and optional minefields. A second expert executes every scenario as an agent, checks feasibility and annotations, and the set is iterated for at least four rounds against multiple model agents. The final 1,032 scenarios are scored by matching database snapshots to milestones in topological order with exact, ROUGE-L, or AST-aware similarities; scores are geometrically aggregated and any minefield hit zeros the result.
